st1111:S25.note: Still a bug visible in code (backend). After Confirm Quantities the demand is re-priced by SalesDemandDomainService.refreshCustomerCategoryDiscount -> applyCustomerCategoryDiscount (~l.1079-1101), which only recalculates the customer-category discount on the line total. st1111:S25.expected: Total stays 66.96 (scheme applied once, trade discount on the agreed base).
st1111:S25.actual: Summary becomes Gross 80, Discount 7% 5.60, total 74.40; order, invoice and journal use 74.40; scheme 8.00 is lost. Cashback behaves the same.
st1111:S25.where: BE SalesDemandDomainService.refreshCustomerCategoryDiscount / applyCustomerCategoryDiscount; SalesDemandCoordinationService.verifyQuantity; FE field-force ase-create-demand use-trade-discount.ts (preview only)
st1111:S25.verify: Repeat the steps on deployment/dev; after the fix GET /api/sales/demands/{id} after Confirm Quantities must still show the scheme reduction and the same total as the ASE review.

rv-fe:sales:18.note: Mostly by design, not a frontend defect: the backend also takes Modern Trade VAT flat (rate x price, 15.8% of 100 = 15.80) via SalesTax.tax(..., flat=true) (SalesTax.java). The frontend grid mirrors it (utils.ts:471-473 K = L x 15.8%, matching the client sheet). What remains: the grid uses the constant SALES_DEMAND_VAT_RATE 0.158 (utils.ts:174) and ignores the item's own tax rate. Same business question as st1111:S19.
rv-fe:sales:18.summary: The demand form computes VAT with a fixed 15.8 percent. For Modern Trade it takes 15.8% of the already VAT-inclusive price (flat) instead of extracting it, which gives a higher VAT than extraction (25.28 instead of 21.84 on 160). Retail channels should carry no VAT.
steps: Open /sales-demand/demand-order/new, choose a Modern Trade customer.
Add Item A with offer TP 8 x 20 (total 160).
Read the VAT & AIT cell and the summary.
rv-fe:sales:18.expected: VAT method follows the channel rule stated by the client, with the item's rate.
rv-fe:sales:18.actual: VAT 25.28 (15.8% flat), same as the backend; item tax rate not read.
rv-fe:sales:18.verify: Get the written rule from the client; compare the form VAT with GET /api/sales/demands/{id} line taxAmount for one MT demand (they must match).

rv-fe:sales:21.note: Still visible in code: the lineTaxRate comment says retail has no VAT and the discount base is gross (use-trade-discount.ts ~l.150-157), but useDemandValueSummary computes the discount base net of the item's tax (amountNetOfTax, same file ~l.188-196) and its doc comment says 'goods net of it'. The two disagree.
rv-fe:sales:21.summary: The Field Force ASE review screen computes the trade discount on a base that its own comments contradict. If the item carries a 15.8% rate the preview shows less discount than the backend settles (8,640 at 7%: base 7,461 instead of 8,640).
